name: Petalburg City
lines:
Ah, a journey is a wonderful thing!
When I was young, I also roamed
across the seas and the mountains!

Sigh...
I wish I could go on an adventure with Pokémon...
Crawl through some damp grass...
Climb rocky, rugged mountains...
Cross the raging seas...
Wander about in dark caves...
And sometimes get a little homesick...
It must be fabulous to travel!
